hypothesis: For two finite sources (uniform on n=4 symbols, Bernoulli(0.3)) under Hamming distortion, the Shannon rate-distortion function R(D) matches its closed form at every point of the pre-registered D-grid, the explicit RD-optimal test channel achieves I(X;X_hat) = R(D), R(0) equals the source entropy (Theorem 1 anchor), R(D_max) = 0, and R is monotone nonincreasing and convex.

controls.description: R(D) computed by the function under test is compared against the closed-form R(D) at every D-grid point; agreement to 1e-9 is required.
The RD-optimal test channel is constructed explicitly (symmetric error-D channel for uniform, Bernoulli-flip channel for Bernoulli) and its I(X;X_hat) is checked to equal R(D) at every D below D_max.
At D = 0 the RD encoder is minimal-sufficient and R(0) = source entropy; this recovers the Theorem 1 partition.
At D = D_max (1 - 1/n for uniform, min(p,1-p) for Bernoulli) the RD encoder is constant and R(D_max) = 0.
For each interior D_i the midpoint inequality R(D_i) <= chord along neighbours holds, verifying convexity along the grid.

gates.criterion: R(D) for the uniform-n=4 Hamming source matches log2(n) - h(D) - D*log2(n-1) at every D in the pre-registered 10-point grid, to 1e-9.
The symmetric error-D test channel for uniform-n=4 achieves I(X;X_hat) = R(D) for every D < 0.75, to 1e-9.
R(0) = log2(n) = 2 bits for the uniform-n=4 source.
R(1 - 1/n) = R(0.75) = 0 for the uniform-n=4 source.
R is nonincreasing in D and satisfies the midpoint convexity inequality on the grid for the uniform-n=4 source.
R(D) for Bernoulli(0.3) Hamming source matches H2(p) - h(D) at every D in the pre-registered 9-point grid, to 1e-9.
The RD-optimal test channel for Bernoulli(0.3) achieves I(X;X_hat) = R(D) for every D < 0.3, to 1e-9.
R is nonincreasing in D and convex on the grid for Bernoulli(0.3).
